## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1: very low sector breadth (2/11) limits a clear risk bias; Confirmation 2: leadership concentrated across three sectors (Tech, Energy, Healthcare) with major divergences among large caps — leadership not broad.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY. Technology is also positive: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND. Energy shows strong single-stock moves despite a weak sector 1W print: MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.86% | 1M: +19.36%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication, Financials and Utilities are weakest: NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND; BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND; CEG (1W: -10.55% | 1M: -7.10%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5) and not broad; style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: BA (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.80%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communication and Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: PANW (1W: +9.96%), AMD (1W: +8.46%), MPC (1W: +7.31%), TMO (1W: +6.91%), ISRG (1W: +6.55%). Note major divergence across large caps (MSFT, AAPL, V, JPM show 1W vs 1M mismatches) — this is a MAJOR DIVERGENCE; watch for trend breaks and treat moves as tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with pockets of strength and short-term pullbacks; AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +2.15%) CORRECTION. Tech breadth: 12/24 positive (internal rotation); monitor MSFT and other megacaps for confirmation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Weak and broadly negative: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.84% | 1M: -2.12%) BELOW TREND. Financials breadth: 4/20 positive — sector showing weakness, not leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Relative safe-haven / selective leadership: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.34% | 1M: -9.95%) RECOVERY. Healthcare breadth: 11/17 positive — sector is a primary contributor to the market’s limited upside.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to Healthcare and high-conviction Tech leaders while reducing exposure to weak Communication and broad Financials positions; prefer names with confirmed ABOVE TREND price action. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; given NEUTRAL regime and major divergences, keep positions tactical and wait for broader breadth confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -12.07% | 1M: -15.94%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (11/17 positive) — leadership candidate to watch. BEARISH: Communication (1/10 positive) and Financials (4/20 positive) — watch for continued outflows and earnings/credit headlines.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) key support near prior consolidation; NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) watch near short-term resistance for above-trend confirmation; AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) monitor for follow-through above recent breakout; BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) watch downside momentum and credit-loss headlines as triggers.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ISRG (+70): ISRG wins EU nod — ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY, bullish news confirmed by strong 1W move but 1M divergence. MPC (+60): analyst upgrades / earnings beat — MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. AMD (+55): positive narrative on upside — AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
CVS (-85): $949m verdict — CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. BAC (-80): bond-loss headline — BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. NFLX (-50): downgrade/engagement concerns — NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND and TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND and NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND show clear weakness. Key risk: very low breadth (2/11) and major divergences among megacaps — watch for trend confirmation before expanding exposure.
